card.name: Politics and history text, mixed positions
card.fires_on: Small words and digits inside US political or historical prose, such as 'the' after 'since', a digit inside a year, or 'The' in a book title. The marked word itself is ordinary; the setting is government, law, or history.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A single digit within a year or number in a political or historical passage.

modes.label: Small words before historical terms
modes.description: A common word such as the, in, or former right before a government or history phrase.

modes.label: Titles and case names
modes.description: The first letters or opening word of a book title or legal case name.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward political terms such as Dem, rep, house, and constitution.
card.plain: It fires on small words and digits in political and history writing, and helps predict terms like Democrat or House.
